headline: Japan Suspends Intervention in Foreign Exchange Market Amid Yen Appreciation - Diário do Grande ABC
summary: Japan has suspended its intervention in the foreign exchange market amid yen appreciation, according to the report. No further details on the size or timing were provided.
why: Japan's Ministry of Finance can buy or sell yen to influence its exchange rate, and currency moves affect Japanese exporters, importers and global carry trades.
why_moved: Japan halted its foreign exchange intervention while the yen was appreciating, which removes state support for the currency's weakness.
